issues: React hydration warnings: visual-editor wrapper <span style={display:contents}> is being injected as a child of <thead>/<tbody>/<tr>, producing repeated 'cannot be a child of' warnings in console. critical_code_review_comments: applyFilters() and downloadPdf() still duplicate the params-building logic (4 identical lines each). Recommend extracting buildFilterParams() helper to prevent future drift — exactly the kind of mismatch that caused the iteration_83 HIGH bug.
Tienda list still shows two identical 'Altamira' labels when no RIF is filtered — consider appending RIF tag (e.g., 'Altamira · Barako') so users can disambiguate without using the RIF cascade.
Consider adding a small 'X de Y tiendas' counter beside the Vista previa button so users see at a glance how many stores will appear after filtering.
